quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's historic two-way performance in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Both of those moments could be turned into statues. In fact, I suggest turning both of them into statues.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: OG Anunoby in this game had two moments within about three minutes of real time. Everyone's talking about this tip-in. Unbelievable. Scott, both of those moments could be turned into statues. In fact, I suggest turning both of them into statues. You should have a double statue. Here's the first one, right there. And then he makes the tip-in and those two things happen back-to-back within seconds. He may have just played one of the greatest halves in the history of the sport.

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: What about the block on Fox?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises OG Anunoby's two-way versatility and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: When you talk about one of the best two-way players in the game, he's been that in the postseason.
quotes.quote: When you talk about one of the best two-way players in the game, he's been that in the postseason. Look at him getting to his bag, get separation on that three-point shot. That was all him. Nobody created for him. And then you talk about his on-the-ball defense, and we talk about being able to contain the ball without getting screened. Look at the activity. When you talk about wanting to guard, this is how you guard. You be the instigator and not the retaliator.
